clips.title: The story
paras: An Unwelcome Guest is a local task in Lakeshire where resident Martie Jainrose seeks retribution against Bellygrub, a destructive wild boar. The beast has rampaged through her garden and trampled her seasonal daffodils, prompting a bounty on the creature's tusk.

In the lakeside town of Lakeshire, Martie Jainrose tends to her domestic grounds amidst the gathering shadows over the Redridge Mountains. Her quiet routine is shattered by a persistent local terror: a notoriously aggressive wild boar that has repeatedly invaded her garden. Having trampled her prized patch of daffodils beyond recovery for the season, the distraught resident turns to capable travelers to put an end to the rampaging animal.

The beast responsible is known to the locals as Bellygrub, an apt title coined by Lakeshire's town guard leader, Marshal Marris. Bellygrub spends the bulk of his time rooting and foraging through the brush in the fields southwest of the town. However, his voracious appetite and boldness often draw him dangerously close to civilized homes, culminating in the complete ruin of Martie's floral beds and demanding his definitive removal.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged. And I know the brute who is doing it. It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.

I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now. Ruined! All ruined by that one menacing boar. Put an end to that pest! Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you. He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally the menace is laid to rest! Thank you, friend, you have done me a great service. The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
